controles.affirmation: Le proces False Claims Act sur le codage Medicare (plainte de 2011) n'est pas clos : le DOJ a conteste en avril 2025 le rapport recommandant un jugement en faveur de la societe
controles.verbatim_source: "In March 2025, a Special Master appointed by the court issued a report recommending that the court enter summary judgment in the Company's favor on all remaining claims. In April 2025, the DOJ filed a motion asking the court to reject the Special Master's report. The Company cannot reasonably estimate the outcome which may result from this matter given its procedural status." (10-Q T2 2026). Citation de preuve de l'ATT exacte au mot pres.

controles.affirmation: La societe repond a des assignations et demandes d'information d'autorites publiques
controles.verbatim_source: "The Company has also been responding to subpoenas, information requests and investigations from governmental entities." (10-Q T2 2026). Le document mentionne aussi explicitement DOJ, SEC, IRS, OIG, CMS, FTC parmi les autorites concernees, ce qui soutient le 'empilement d'enquetes federales' du hook.

controles.affirmation: Des audits RADV de CMS peuvent entrainer des remboursements retroactifs
controles.verbatim_source: "CMS and OIG have selected certain of the Company's local plans for risk adjustment data validation (RADV) audits ... and such audits may result in retrospective adjustments to payments made to the Company's health plans."

controles.affirmation: L'IRS a notifie en mars 2026 des redressements sur les prix de transfert 2017-2020 visant a augmenter significativement le revenu imposable, extensibles aux annees suivantes
controles.verbatim_source: "On March 6, 2026, the Company received Notices of Proposed Adjustment (“NOPAs”) from the IRS for transactions undertaken during the 2017 through 2020 tax years involving intercompany transfer pricing with a foreign subsidiary. The IRS is seeking to significantly increase taxable income for each of the applicable periods and could also seek similar adjustments for subsequent years after 2020."
controles.correction_proposee: Precision recommandee : ecrire 'propositions de redressement (NOPAs)' plutot que 'redressements', un NOPA etant une proposition d'ajustement au stade du controle, pas une imposition etablie. La suite de l'ATT ('visant a augmenter') restitue deja correctement ce caractere propose.

Couts medicaux en hausse de 19% en 2025

controles.verbatim_source: "Diluted earnings per share ... $13.23 $15.51 $23.86" (10-K FY2025). Calcul : 13,23/23,86 = -44,6%, arrondi -45%.
"Medical care ratio (a) 89.1 % 85.5 % 83.2 %" (10-K FY2025) ; "Medical care ratio (a) 86.7 % 89.4 %" (10-Q T2 2026).

controles.verbatim_source: Tableau 10-Q T2 2026 : "Risk-based 7,655 8,440 (785) (9) % ... Medicare Advantage 7,565 8,350 (785) (9) ... Medicaid 6,780 7,490 (710) (9) ... Total UnitedHealthcare - Medical 48,525 50,115 (1,590) (3) %".

controles.verbatim_source: Citation "causing contraction in our Medicare Advantage membership, which we expect to continue throughout 2026" presente mot pour mot dans le 10-Q T2 2026.

"UnitedHealthcare served 415,000 more people domestically, driven by growth in fee-based commercial offerings and Medicare Advantage, partially offset by risk-based commercial offerings." (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: Optum Health : revenus T2 2026 de 23 472 M$ vs 24 725 M$ (-5%) ; perte nette de 341 M$ sur cessions au S1 2026 ; contraction des patients en value-based care
controles.verbatim_source: "Optum Health (a) 23,472 24,725 (1,253) (5)" ; "partially offset by a net loss of $341 million at Optum Health" (impacts cumules a fin juin 2026) ; citation value-based care presente mot pour mot dans le 10-Q.

controles.affirmation: Cyberattaque Change Healthcare : 799 M$ de reserves supplementaires au T4 2025 ; la societe s'attend a d'autres incidents
controles.verbatim_source: "In the fourth quarter of 2025, the Company increased its reserves for net collection expectations associated with provider loans and other customer balances of $799 million" ; "we expect that we will continue to experience incidents, some of which may negatively affect our business" (10-K FY2025). Les deux citations de l'ATT sont exactes.

controles.affirmation: Medicare & Retirement : 42 390 M$ sur 86 017 M$ de revenus UnitedHealthcare au T2 2026 (environ la moitie)
Taux de base Medicare Advantage sous le trend de couts pendant plusieurs annees, notice finale 2027 toujours en dessous, revisions du modele d'ajustement au risque reduisant le financement
controles.verbatim_source: "Medicare Advantage rate notices for numerous years have resulted in industry base rates well below the industry forward medical cost trend. While the Final Notice for 2027 moved towards the expected industry forward medical cost trend, it remains below. ... substantial revisions to the risk adjustment model ... have resulted and will continue to result in reduced funding".

controles.affirmation: Medicaid : environnement de taux insuffisant ; remboursement des profits 2026 des exchanges ; No Surprises Act
controles.verbatim_source: "The funding and payment rate environment remains insufficient to meet the health needs of patients" ; "we have voluntarily pledged to rebate 2026 profits on our individual exchange products" ; "higher provider reimbursement under the No Surprises Act" - les trois citations sont presentes mot pour mot dans le 10-Q T2 2026.

controles.affirmation: La societe ecrit que le trend de couts medicaux reste au-dessus des niveaux historiques
controles.verbatim_source: "elevated medical cost trend which remains above historical levels" - present mot pour mot dans le 10-Q T2 2026.
